name: Pokemon-Extender
description: Your favourite card, framed like a graded slab: printed, cut and ready for the acrylic case. Upload a picture of a Pokémon card whose artwork carries on past the card's edge (painted by hand or extended with any AI tool). Pokemon-Extender finds the card, uses it as a ruler (a card is 63 x 88 mm) and turns the picture into an insert for a PSA- or BGS-style case: a print sheet in the exact size of the slab, with the cut lines for the outline, the label window and the card window. Downloads: an SVG that Bambu Suite takes as it is for Print Then Cut (H2D/H2S with the cutting module), the print with the cut path for other cutters, PDF/PNG and a DXF. Slab measurements come from templates you can correct. One picture takes a second; no GPU, no AI model, no account. English, Deutsch, Français and Lëtzebuergesch. There is no login: keep it in your LAN and never forward the port to the internet.
